description: We are a multidisciplinary team for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Gaurav Kokate (AIML), Kunal Tilekar (Cybersecurity), Om Arote (Cybersecurity), Gokul Chaudhari(AIML)Vrushank Sable (Cyber security),Durgesh Gaikwad(cyber security).
